products.title: BROOKS X SUN
products.body_html:
One of our best-selling designs from our first-ever collection, the Brooks is back in honor of our 10th anniversary. Redesigned with a thicker acetate construction and a new plaque inspired by the GLCO logo, its classic facade is infused with a hint of bookish charm.

To commemorate our 10th anniversary, the re-envisioned Brooks will come with an exclusive anniversary-edition soft case, case wrapper in our signature orange, anniversary-edition cleaning cloth, and a special inscription on the inside temples. Cheers to "Ten Years of Vision."

products.title: HAMPTON X SUN
products.body_html: In a nod to our beginnings, we redesigned the Hampton, our first and bestselling frame from our original collection 10 years ago. With a thicker acetate construction, Premium Glass lenses, and a special plaque inspired by the GLCO logo, it's a bold, statement-making silhouette.

products.title: HARDING SUN
products.body_html: A GLCO icon, this masculine, retro-influenced sunglass features a prominent single bridge, bold acetate front, and Premium Glass Semi-Flat lenses with 100% UV protection. Detailed with metal plaques and a keyhole bridge.

products.title: HAMPTON X
products.body_html: As a nod to our beginnings, we redesigned the Hampton, our first and bestselling frame from our original collection. With a thicker acetate construction and glass lenses it's a bold, statement-making silhouette with a classic feel.

products.title: CLARK
products.body_html: A favorite optical design, Clark takes a back-to-basics approach with balanced proportions, a keyhole bridge, and slim temples.

products.title: ACE SUN
products.body_html:
With bold lines and fine details, the Ace is for the strong and not-so-silent types. Featuring a palm leaf plaque adorning the frame front and glass lenses for unmatched clarity, the Ace is a striking choice for the discerning wearer.

Appearances matter, and no one lives this better than the wearer of the Ace. Assured and well-connected, he's the guy who always gets it right.
